fact: Reporting the 2025 National Budget speech, Zambia Monitor says the Ministry planned to invest K120.0 million in the continued improvement of the healthcare management information system, within a K23.2 billion health allocation; the article does not name DHIS2 or say which system the phrase covers.
title: Govt sets aside K23.2 billion for health sector in 2025, aims to recruit 2,000 frontline health personnel
